description: React component for cost tracking settings, including fetching, displaying, and updating provider discounts with UI elements and network interactions.

classes.name: CostTrackingSettings
classes.description: React functional component for managing cost tracking settings, including discount configuration for providers.

methods.name: fetchDiscountConfig
methods.description: Fetches current discount configuration from backend API.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current discount configuration to backend API.

methods.name: handleAddProvider
methods.description: Adds a new provider discount to the configuration.

methods.name: handleRemoveProvider
methods.description: Removes a provider from the discount configuration.

methods.name: handleDiscountChange
methods.description: Updates the discount value for a specific provider.
